title.zh: 杜鲁门承认以色列的声明

caption.en: The statement approved on 14 May 1948 recognizes Israel’s provisional government as the de facto authority. Handwritten changes specify the state’s name.
caption.zh: 1948年5月14日批准的声明承认以色列临时政府为事实上的当局。手写修改明确了国家名称。

alt.en: A typed statement on cream paper, with crossed-out words, handwritten corrections, Harry Truman’s signature and a handwritten approval date.
alt.zh: 米色纸上的打字声明，带划除文字、手写修改、哈里·杜鲁门签名和手写批准日期。

interpretation.en: Handwritten changes identify the State of Israel, while the text recognizes its provisional government. The statement records a U.S. diplomatic decision during the war. Palestinian displacement and dispossession, central to the accompanying story, are absent from this document.
interpretation.zh: 手写修改明确了以色列国的名称，正文承认其临时政府。声明记录战争期间美国的一项外交决定。关联故事所述的巴勒斯坦人流离失所与财产丧失，没有出现在这份文书中。

title.en: Mandela arriving for a U.S. state visit

caption.en: Colonel Acuff greets South African President Nelson Mandela beside his aircraft on 4 October 1994, during the first year of his presidency.
caption.zh: 1994年10月4日，阿卡夫上校在飞机旁迎接南非总统纳尔逊·曼德拉；当年是曼德拉就任总统的第一年。

alt.en: Nelson Mandela shakes hands with a uniformed officer beside an aircraft, while other visitors descend the stairs behind him.
alt.zh: 纳尔逊·曼德拉在飞机旁与一名军官握手，其他来宾在他身后走下舷梯。

interpretation.en: The military ceremony shows Mandela taking part in international diplomacy during his first year as president. His new role followed the 1994 election and the wider collective struggle against apartheid described in the biography.
interpretation.zh: 军事迎接仪式展现曼德拉在总统任期第一年参与国际外交。他的新角色承接1994年选举，以及传记所述更广泛的反种族隔离集体斗争。

title.en: Buzz Aldrin on the lunar surface
title.zh: 月球表面的巴兹·奥尔德林

caption.en: Neil Armstrong photographed Edwin “Buzz” Aldrin near the lunar module during Apollo 11. NARA dates the photograph to 20 July 1969.
caption.zh: 尼尔·阿姆斯特朗在阿波罗11号任务中拍摄月球舱附近的埃德温“巴兹”·奥尔德林。国家档案馆将照片记为1969年7月20日。

interpretation.en: The mission photograph documents lunar surface work, while the atlas map marks the launch site on Earth. The image is one part of a mission also dependent on Michael Collins in lunar orbit and extensive ground teams.
interpretation.zh: 任务照片记录月面活动，而地图标记的是地球上的发射地点。照片只是任务的一部分，任务还依靠留在月球轨道上的迈克尔·柯林斯及庞大的地面团队。

title.zh: 瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔1998年的国事访问抵达仪式

caption.en: Czech President Václav Havel, left, stands with President Bill Clinton for the U.S. national anthem on the White House South Lawn, 16 September 1998.
caption.zh: 1998年9月16日，捷克总统瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔（左）与美国总统比尔·克林顿在白宫南草坪肃立聆听美国国歌。

alt.en: Václav Havel and Bill Clinton stand in dark suits outdoors; Clinton holds his right hand over his chest.
alt.zh: 瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔与比尔·克林顿身穿深色西装站在户外；克林顿把右手放在胸前。

interpretation.en: The anthem ceremony presents Havel as president of the Czech Republic in 1998. It belongs to the later chapter of a life that moved from theatre and Charter 77 dissent through the 1989 transition into constitutional office.
interpretation.zh: 国歌仪式呈现1998年身为捷克共和国总统的哈维尔。这是他人生中较晚的篇章，此前经历了戏剧创作、《七七宪章》异议活动及1989年转型，随后担任宪制公职。

caption.en: A family looks from a train window in the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s 1944 “Photograph of Mexican Laborers.” DocsTeach places the image in the Bracero Program’s cross-border labour context.
caption.zh: 一家人从火车窗口向外看；此图是美国农业部1944年的《墨西哥劳工照片》。DocsTeach将其置于布拉塞罗计划的跨境劳动背景中。

interpretation.en: The image makes household travel visible, but the source does not name the family or establish their individual contracts. A government photograph cannot show whether promised pay and housing protections were fulfilled.
interpretation.zh: 照片让家庭出行变得可见，但来源没有提供家人姓名，也不能确立每个人的合约身份。政府照片无法说明承诺的工资与住房保障是否兑现。

title.en: An opening in the Berlin Wall at Potsdamer Platz
title.zh: 波茨坦广场的柏林墙开口

caption.en: West Berliners gather at a newly opened gap in the Berlin Wall at Potsdamer Platz on 14 November 1989, five days after border crossings first opened.
caption.zh: 1989年11月14日，西柏林居民聚集在波茨坦广场柏林墙的新开口旁；距边境通道最初开放已过五天。

alt.en: A crowd gathers between graffiti-covered sections of wall; several people stand on large bins to look through the opening.
alt.zh: 人群聚集在涂鸦覆盖的墙段之间；几人站在大型垃圾箱上向开口处张望。

interpretation.en: People climb onto bins to see through a new gap in a barrier that had divided the city. This is 14 November, after crossings first opened on 9 November 1989. German reunification followed in 1990.
interpretation.zh: 人们站上垃圾箱，透过曾分隔城市的屏障新开出的缺口向外看。此时是11月14日，晚于1989年11月9日边境通道首次开放；德国统一则发生在1990年。

caption.en: Martin Luther King Jr. speaks at the March on Washington on 28 August 1963, in a photograph filed by the U.S. Information Agency.
caption.zh: 1963年8月28日，小马丁·路德·金在华盛顿大游行中演讲；此照片存于美国新闻署档案中。

title.en: Apollo 11: from Earth to the Moon
title.zh: 阿波罗11号：从地球到月球

location.label: Kennedy Space Center; Earth launch location

summary.en: Apollo 11 launched from Cape Kennedy on 16 July 1969 with Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin and Michael Collins. Armstrong and Aldrin reached the lunar surface while Collins remained in lunar orbit. The mission combined landing and return objectives with scientific observations, experiments and sample collection. This Earth map places the event at its launch site, not at the landing location on the Moon; it offers a starting point for following a journey beyond the map.
summary.zh: 1969年7月16日，阿波罗11号载着尼尔·阿姆斯特朗、巴兹·奥尔德林和迈克尔·柯林斯从肯尼迪角发射。阿姆斯特朗与奥尔德林到达月面，柯林斯留在绕月轨道。任务把登月和返回地球与观测、实验、样本采集结合起来。这张地球地图标示的是发射地点，而不是月球上的着陆点。

dateNote.en: Single-year mission; launch 16 July, lunar landing 20 July 1969. Coordinates are the Earth launch site.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份任务：1969年7月16日发射，7月20日登月；坐标为地球发射地点。

title.zh: 1989：柏林墙开放

summary.en: The opening of the Berlin Wall became a defining image of the upheavals that transformed Eastern Europe in 1989. Demonstrations, opposition movements and changes in Soviet policy weakened governments that had restricted political participation and movement. The border opening was part of this broader process, not its only cause. Different countries followed different paths, and the collapse of communist rule did not resolve every social or economic dispute. Berlin’s division had embodied the Cold War in a single city; its opening made a new European political order imaginable while leaving the work of reunification and institutional change ahead.
summary.zh: 柏林墙开放成为1989年东欧剧变的标志。示威、反对运动和苏联政策变化，削弱了限制政治参与与人员流动的政府。边界开放属于更广过程，并非唯一原因。各国路径不同，共产党统治结束也未解决所有社会经济争议。柏林分裂曾把冷战具象为一座城市；开放使新的欧洲秩序成为可能，但统一与制度转型仍待完成。

dateNote.en: Border crossings opened on 9 November 1989; German reunification followed in 1990 and the Soviet Union dissolved in 1991.
dateNote.zh: 边境通道于1989年11月9日开放；德国于1990年统一，苏联于1991年解体。

title.en: 1947–1949: partition proposals, Israel’s establishment and Palestinian displacement
title.zh: 1947—1949年：分治建议、以色列建国与巴勒斯坦人流离

labelI18n.zh: 耶路撒冷；地区的代表性参考位置

summary.en:
In 1947 the UN General Assembly recommended partition of the British Mandate territory into Arab and Jewish states with a special arrangement for Jerusalem. The recommendation was followed by war, the end of British rule and Israel’s declaration of establishment in May 1948. The military outcome did not simply implement the proposed map.

Palestinians experienced mass displacement and dispossession, remembered as the Nakba, while Israeli state institutions emerged amid war and competing claims to sovereignty. A founding declaration records one political project; it does not resolve the history or rights of every population affected. This entry connects the events without treating refugee displacement as an incidental footnote or presenting 1949 armistice lines as universally agreed permanent borders. Source perspectives and the difference between proposals, declarations, control and recognition remain visible.
summary.zh:
1947年联合国大会建议将英国委任统治地区分为阿拉伯国和犹太国，并为耶路撒冷设置特别安排。随后发生战争、英国统治结束，以及以色列于1948年5月宣布建国。军事结果并非简单落实建议地图。

巴勒斯坦人遭受大规模流离和财产剥夺，以“纳克巴”即灾难记忆；以色列国家机构则在战争及相互竞争的主权主张中形成。建国宣言记录一种政治计划，不能解决所有受影响人口的历史或权利。本条把事件联系起来，既不把难民流离视为附带脚注，也不把1949年停战线当作普遍同意的永久边界，并保留建议、宣告、控制与承认之间的区别。

dateNote.en: 1947–1949 transition and war. All three institutional bodies were inspected through indexed text because full pages failed or redirected. No new boundary geometry, casualty total or present legal-status claim is supplied.

title.en: Bracero contracts · Promises, work and remembered choices
title.zh: 布拉塞罗契约 · 承诺、劳动与回忆中的选择

location.label: Mexicali–Calexico border region, representative labour corridor

labelI18n.en: Mexicali–Calexico border region, representative labour corridor
labelI18n.zh: 墨西卡利—卡莱克西科边境，代表性劳工通道

summary.en: Between 1942 and 1964, agreements between Mexico and the United States brought Mexican workers north on temporary contracts. The paperwork promised protections for wages, housing and return transport; enforcement often fell short. Oral histories reveal decisions that an administrative total cannot explain. Ángel Guzmán Domínguez remembered friends gathering around a letter from the United States, then the uncertainty of recruitment and the lack of choice over assigned work. Other family testimony described debts and the effort to combine field labour with education. Labour archives preserve another perspective: organizers’ correspondence and campaigns over wages and the use of imported workers. Reading these sources together connects migration to household plans, employer power and collective action, without treating every contract as a different person or every worker’s experience as the same.
summary.zh: 1942至1964年，墨美两国协议使墨西哥劳工持短期契约赴美工作。文书承诺工资、住房与返乡交通方面的保护，执行却常有落差。口述历史揭示行政总数无法解释的选择。安赫尔·古斯曼·多明格斯回忆，朋友们围看一封来自美国的信，随后面对招募的不确定，以及无法自行选择所分配工作的处境。另一些家庭证词描述债务，以及兼顾田间劳动与求学的努力。劳工档案保存另一视角：组织者围绕工资和引入劳工问题的通信与行动。将这些材料并读，可把迁移与家庭计划、雇主权力和集体行动相连，同时避免把每份契约算作不同个人，或把所有劳工经验写成一样。

title.en: Nelson Mandela · From resistance to democratic transition
title.zh: 纳尔逊·曼德拉 · 从抵抗到民主转型

summary.en: Nelson Mandela’s political life unfolded within a much larger struggle against apartheid. He helped build the African National Congress Youth League, worked in legal and mass-action campaigns, and later supported armed resistance after the state closed avenues for peaceful opposition. Imprisonment separated him from public political life for decades, but did not end the movement. His release in 1990 and subsequent negotiations helped create conditions for the inclusive national election of 1994. As president, he faced the difficult task of turning political rights into a new governing order. His biography is most useful when read with the work of fellow activists, communities, and negotiating partners whose choices also shaped the transition.
summary.zh: 曼德拉的政治生涯属于更广泛的反种族隔离斗争。他参与建立非洲人国民大会青年联盟，投入法律工作和群众运动，并在国家堵塞和平反对途径后支持武装抵抗。数十年的监禁使他远离公开政治生活，却未终止整个运动。1990年获释以及随后的谈判，帮助创造了1994年包容性全国选举的条件。担任总统后，他面对把政治权利转化为新治理秩序的艰难任务。将其生平与其他活动者、社区及谈判参与者并读，更能理解共同塑造转型的多种选择。

dateNote.en: Lifespan 1918–2013. The 1990 release and 1994 election/inauguration are distinct stages of a longer transition.
dateNote.zh: 生卒年为1918—2013年。1990年获释与1994年选举、就职，是长期转型中的不同阶段。

title.en: Rachel Carson · Making ecological relationships public
title.zh: 蕾切尔·卡森 · 让生态关系进入公共讨论

summary.en:
Rachel Carson combined work as a marine biologist with writing for a broad public. At the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service she prepared and edited publications that explained wildlife and ecological relationships. The success of The Sea Around Us in 1951 allowed her to devote more time to independent writing.

Silent Spring, published in 1962, assembled research on the effects of pesticide use across living systems. Carson worked with other scientists and researchers, making the book a synthesis of collective evidence as well as an individual literary achievement. Industry opposition and public debate made questions about environmental responsibility matters of political authority. Her work helped enlarge the audience for ecological thinking. It did not call for the simple rejection of all science or all pest control; it asked how evidence about harm should change decisions affecting shared environments.
summary.zh:
蕾切尔·卡森把海洋生物学工作同面向大众的写作结合。在美国鱼类及野生动物管理局，她撰写和编辑解释野生动物与生态关系的出版物。1951年《我们周围的海洋》成功后，她得以投入更多时间独立写作。

1962年出版的《寂静的春天》，汇集农药使用影响生命系统的研究。卡森与其他科学家和研究者合作，因此这本书既是个人文学成就，也是集体证据的综合。行业反对与公众辩论，使环境责任成为政治权威问题。她的工作扩大生态思维的公众范围，并非主张简单拒绝全部科学或害虫防治，而是追问危害证据应如何改变影响共同环境的决定。

dateNote.en: Lifespan 1907–1964; publication years distinguish the public milestones from later policy changes.
dateNote.zh: 生卒年1907—1964；出版年份同后来的政策变化区分。

title.en: Václav Havel · Theatre, dissent and constitutional office
title.zh: 瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔 · 戏剧、异议与宪制职位

location.label: Prague; representative theatre and political setting

summary.en:
Havel’s career linked theatre and public argument to organized dissent in communist Czechoslovakia. Restrictions on publication and repeated imprisonment shaped the conditions under which he wrote. Charter 77, for which he served as one of the first spokespersons, joined particular people in a rights-based initiative; it was not simply another name for the whole population’s political views.

In November 1989 he became a leading representative of Civic Forum, and the Federal Assembly elected him president on 29 December. He later became the first president of the separate Czech Republic. The transition from dissident writer to office-holder raises questions about institutions, compromise and the responsibilities of governing, not only personal moral reputation. His plays, essays, documents and the testimony of others provide different kinds of evidence. This biography connects the Prague Spring, later civic mobilization and the constitutional changes already represented elsewhere in the atlas.
summary.zh:
哈维尔的生涯把戏剧与公共论辩，同共产主义捷克斯洛伐克的有组织异议联系起来。出版限制和反复入狱，塑造了其写作条件。他担任七七宪章最初发言人之一；这项以权利为基础的行动联系特定参与者，并不等于全体人口政治观点的另一个名称。

1989年11月，他成为公民论坛的重要代表，联邦议会于12月29日选举他为总统。后来，他成为独立捷克共和国的首任总统。从异议作家到任职者的转变，提出关于制度、妥协和治理责任的问题，而不只是个人道德声望。戏剧、散文、文书及其他人的证言，提供不同类型的证据。本传记连接布拉格之春、后来的公民动员，以及本图其他条目已呈现的宪制变化。

dateNote.en: Life: 1936–2011. Election to Czechoslovak president: 29 December 1989, following Prague Castle; the library timeline’s 1990 heading is inconsistent.

title.en: Martin Luther King Jr. · Churches, collective action and economic justice
title.zh: 小马丁·路德·金 · 教会、集体行动与经济正义

location.label: Atlanta, Georgia; Ebenezer Baptist Church and organizing context

summary.en:
Martin Luther King Jr. developed his public voice through education, Baptist ministry and organized struggle against segregation. Study at Morehouse, Crozer and Boston University preceded his 1954 pastorate at Dexter Avenue Baptist Church in Montgomery. When the city’s Black residents began their bus boycott in 1955, he became a leading spokesman within a campaign sustained by many organizers, churches, workers and households.

The boycott exposed him and his family to arrest, bombing and intimidation. His subsequent leadership in the Southern Christian Leadership Conference helped connect local campaigns, drawing on Christian argument and nonviolent action. From 1960 he also served as co-pastor at Atlanta’s Ebenezer Baptist Church. A church was a workplace and organizing institution, not only the setting for memorable speeches.

The Nobel Peace Prize in 1964 recognized his movement leadership, but recognition did not complete the struggle. In 1968 Memphis sanitation workers demanded union recognition, safer equipment and adequate wages after two colleagues were killed. Their campaign had its own local leaders and a history preceding King’s arrival. He joined because racial equality and economic justice could not be separated.

The March protest he helped lead ended in violence, and police attacked demonstrators; he nevertheless returned to support continued nonviolent organizing. He was assassinated at the Lorraine Motel on 4 April. Workers and supporters continued afterward, reaching an agreement later that month. His life story therefore points outward to the institutions and collective labor that made action possible, rather than making one speaker responsible for every civil-rights achievement.
summary.zh:
小马丁·路德·金通过教育、浸信会牧职及反对种族隔离的组织行动，形成公共表达。在莫尔豪斯学院、克罗泽神学院与波士顿大学学习后，他1954年到蒙哥马利德克斯特大道浸信会教堂任牧师。1955年当地黑人居民开始抵制公共汽车时，他成为重要发言人；运动依靠众多组织者、教会、工人和家庭维持。

抵制使他及家人遭遇逮捕、炸弹袭击与恐吓。此后他领导南方基督教领袖会议，以基督教论述和非暴力行动连接地方运动。自1960年起，他还在亚特兰大埃比尼泽浸信会教堂担任共同牧师。教会是工作与组织机构，不只是著名演讲的背景。

1964年诺贝尔和平奖认可其运动领导作用，但获奖并未完成斗争。1968年，两位同事遇难后，孟菲斯清洁工要求工会承认、较安全的设备和足够工资。当地运动有自己的领袖和早于金到访的历史。他参与是因为种族平等与经济正义无法分开。

他协助领导的3月示威以暴力告终，警察袭击参加者；他仍返回支持继续的非暴力组织。4月4日，他在洛林汽车旅馆遇刺。工人和支持者随后继续行动，在当月晚些时候达成协议。其生平因此把目光引向使行动成为可能的制度与集体劳动，而不把所有民权成果归于一位演说者。

dateNote.en: Lifespan 1929–1968. Milestones distinguish Montgomery pastorate/boycott, Atlanta co-pastorate and Memphis support/assassination. The source biography’s historical terminology is not adopted as current narration. Local workers’ struggle continued after his death.
dateNote.zh: 生卒1929—1968年。节点区分蒙哥马利牧职与抵制、亚特兰大共同牧职，以及在孟菲斯的支持行动和遇刺。不把来源传记中的历史称谓直接用作当前叙述。当地工人的斗争在他去世后继续。

Dated terminology, numerical publicity claims, sole-leader framing and contemporary party-campaign wording are not adopted.

sources.title: Memphis Sanitation Workers' Strike
sources.publisher: Martin Luther King, Jr. Research and Education Institute, Stanford University
sources.evidenceNote: Actual source text captured centrally through the root Codex in-app browser and read locally by the regional author. Full historical entry: 1 February 1968 deaths of Echol Cole and Robert Walker, 12 February strike, union/safety/wage demands, local organizers and ministers, 18 and 28 March King involvement, police violence, 3 April return, 4 April assassination, 8 April march and 16 April agreement, later enforcement pressure. No King speech text is reproduced.

reviewLimit.en: Source text was captured centrally in the Codex in-app browser and inspected locally for the claims described. This selected narrative does not establish every participant’s experience, exact routes or historical boundaries.
